note: The missing supervisor-to-worker execution layer now exists and is proven with real processes: SupervisedTask spawns a genuine OS worker, holds it to a durable cross-process lease, observes heartbeats and checkpoints, verifies results by independent world readback, and recovers from real kills and timeouts with reconciliation recorded first. A crashed supervisor's task is re-attachable by a new supervisor through a durable binding. A model-query task kind delegates answering to the Ollama backend with supervisor-declared ground truth and match rules, and unreachable backends fail honestly. 12 lifecycle tests pass repeatedly under pytest and unittest; the full Bridge suite passes with them.
